games.title: Patchwork

hero.name: Mender
hero.role: A spare thread of Loom Village

games.blurb: The world is a patchwork, and the god who dreamed it is running out of thread. Mender, a spare thread of Loom Village, follows the patchwork godling Ochre into the First Seam. Three endings wait at the Loom.
games.controls: Arrows or WASD move. Enter, Space, or Z confirms. Esc or X goes back. C opens the party screen. M saves.

games.title: Duotone
games.blurb: The Loom prints every tile in Tessel with black and two hues. Wick got black and amber and nothing else, and the village calls that a misprint. A creature's two colors tell you what hurts it.
games.controls: Arrows or WASD move. Z confirms. X cancels and opens the menu. C shifts time once you have the Pocket Sundial. M mutes.

games.title: The Long Noon
games.blurb: It has been noon for three hundred years. Wick winds the brass Lamp that serves as the sun and finds a forgotten setting on its dial called DUSK. Twelve partymates join the trip to find out who stopped the evening.
games.controls: Arrows or WASD move. Z or Enter confirms. X or Esc cancels and opens the menu.

games.title: The Moth Crown
games.blurb: Pell scrapes salt at the edge of a world built around a dying star. When the village Lamp starts to fail, a moth the size of a cart lands in the square and says Pell's name.
games.controls: Arrows or WASD move. Z or Enter confirms. X or Esc cancels. C opens the menu. Hold Shift to hurry. M mutes.

games.title: Please Hold
games.blurb: Every prayer nobody answers falls to the bottom of everything and grows into the thing it asked for. Hello grew from a wish you are about to type. When the falling stops and collectors start sending people back up, Hello goes to ask where they are taking them.
games.controls: Arrows or WASD move. Z, Space, or Enter confirms. X or Esc cancels and opens the menu. C listens. Shift runs. Tab shows your goal. M mutes. Gamepads work too.

games.title: Plumb
games.blurb: Everyone on the Drop has a hook in the back and a line straight up into a sky that drips. Once a year a line goes tight and somebody is reeled up. Fathom's line comes down instead, with a file knotted into it, and every entry comes true.
games.controls: Arrows or WASD move. Z, Enter, or Space confirms. X or Esc cancels. C opens the menu. Tab shows your goal. Shift hurries. M mutes. Player two uses the mouse. Gamepads work.
